name: Argus
bio: Archetype: ST Debuff, High Tier Skill Synergy, Extra Action. ⌽ Grants all allies a DMG Bonus buff after casting an incantation (Higher Rank = Stronger Buff). ⌽ Skill 2 inflicts [Pinpointed] on one enemy, which increases DMG Taken and decreases Crit DEF. ⌽ [Pinpointed] stacks when holder is hit. ⌽ Casts [Grave Digger] after all ally skills resolve. Its tier depends on the total star count of the skills in the AP area. ⌽ [Grave Digger] grants Moxie at Rank 2-3, and guarantees a Crit at Rank 3. ⌽ Ultimate increases and refreshes [Pinpointed] stacks, and deals damage (more against [Pinpointed] enemies).
